name: 3D and 4D seismic acquisition (towed streamer, ocean-bottom nodes)
aliases: 3D and 4D seismic acquisition (towed streamer, ocean-bottom nodes)
principle: Sound sources generate waves that reflect from subsurface layers and are recorded by receivers: towed streamers (5 to 15 m deep, Ramform vessels tow up to 24), ocean-bottom cables, or battery-powered ocean-bottom nodes placed by ROV. A 4D survey repeats a 3D survey after production starts to watch reservoir changes.

source.note: Wikipedia, Reflection seismology, read 25 October 2026 (secondary source)

performance.basis: spreads can exceed one nautical mile

limitations: Streamer 4D is hard to repeat because of weather, tides and currents
